SUMMARY: hairstyle two high looped ponytails, with a precise center-part fringe; costume silhouette several rigid jointed armor plates flaring from the waist like a skirt — plates, not cloth — with the legs showing between them; design idea Two parallel banks of articulated waist plates share a single mechanical load-bearing belt, expressing steadfast alliance through their structure.; face a coquettish, flirtatious charm — a sidelong glance and a playful pout, light warm-beige skin with a golden undertone, diamond-shaped face with softly defined cheekbones and a tapered chin, smooth monolid eyes of natural size, ember-orange eyes, soft feathered brows, slim, delicate nose with a refined bridge, thin lips with a defined cupid's bow; expression relaxed, lips closed

A full-body character image, vertical 2:3 (1024×1536): Zhang Yang of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the warlord of Henei, an old friend of Lü Bu.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

2. CHARACTER
Age: mid-twenties — a young-adult face.
Face — her own, recognisably this character, a woman's face with no beard or facial hair: a glamorous, sultry allure; light warm-beige skin with a golden undertone; diamond-shaped face with softly defined cheekbones and a tapered chin; smooth monolid eyes of natural size; ember-orange eyes; soft feathered brows; slim, delicate nose with a refined bridge; thin lips with a defined cupid's bow.
Body and hair: hourglass-figured — full bust and hips, distinctly narrow-waisted build; two high looped ponytails, with a precise center-part fringe; turquoise hair.
Expression: a relaxed, unforced face, lips gently closed, subtle and relaxed.
Legend, carried in her design and bearing: loyal friendship and caution, frontier armor.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME AND EQUIPMENT — MECHA
Costume: a female mecha personification built as a command-type mecha — crowned head unit with an antenna crest, cape-like binder wings, heavy chest plating with an emblem core, a flagship back unit. Solid hard-surface plates with visible joints cover her frame except at the openings named under Exposure; any cape or skirt is made of rigid armored plates; her face and hair stay human.
Silhouette: several rigid jointed armor plates flaring from the waist like a skirt — plates, not cloth — with the legs showing between them. This silhouette sets the overall shape of the costume above — keep its materials, ornaments and rank in this shape; the details are free.
Design idea: Two parallel banks of articulated waist plates share a single mechanical load-bearing belt, expressing steadfast alliance through their structure.
Colours: olive green, dusty tan, slate grey and brass. Faction frame: olive and earthen-tan plating with blue-grey trim and brass joints, river-bank bastion silhouette, Yellow River ford motifs, brass glow lines.
Signature item: a long spear, rebuilt as a far-future high-tech version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette — hard-surface alloy plates with panel lines, mechanical joints, vents and emitter nodes, an energy edge, plasma blade or glowing core in her glow-line colour and small status lights, with any animal motif re-sculpted as sleek machined armour. She holds it at full scale: one whole object, drawn once, held in front of or beside her body; a long weapon keeps one straight, unbroken shaft with a single head or blade.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare upper arms below the pauldrons, which stay seated on top of her shoulders, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2190, the Free Zones — a lawless asteroid belt between the three powers: warlord fortresses carved into asteroids, wrecked starships drifting in the dark, a violet nebula, warning lights blinking.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: her whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet inside the frame with clear margins, about four-fifths of the image height; camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only — no second character, horse or other creature. No readable text or numbers — emblems are abstract insignia shapes only, never letters or Chinese characters. No logo, watermark, speech bubble or frame border. A far-future setting only — space stations, starships and high-tech structures — with no traditional East-Asian architecture.
Avoid: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
